verdict.rationale: The SDK's subagents can be spawned to 'run multiple analyses in parallel', and the shared Claude Code foundation documents ways to 'work on several tasks at once'. That is parallel task fan-out rather than an explicit bulk-operation feature for acting on many items in one call. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch operation primitive that applies one action across many items, documented limits or scale of parallel execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Use them to isolate context, run multiple analyses in parallel, and apply specialized instructions
Claude Code has five ways to work on several tasks at once: subagents, agent view, agent teams, dynamic workflows, and projects.
Programmatically: use the `agents` parameter in your `query()` options.
